purpose: Individual reconciliation against each existing scope. Completed review is not product certification or proof that every gap is resolved.

applications.name: Blender
applications.version: Source commit ded7fde71c04f034d6c065e8d0a75d9f548003a0; published SDNA layout and Pack All coverage
E3: Published SDNA definitions explain binary structure layout, while Pack All deliberately skips some external image/movie/linked bake dependencies. Neither a current scene was independently reconstructed nor its complete assets, scripts, node semantics and compatible runtime retained and compared. Available format knowledge is not complete scene survival.
E5: Undo/recovery documentation and pack warnings do not establish effective Python/driver/plugin authorization, save/export overwrite control or correction across asset packing and destructive scene changes. Known pack exclusions are dependency facts, not proof of governable execution.
longevity: E3 is not established for Blender's existing essential-record scope. The previous Longevity finding is replaced by Not assessed, not a verified failure or a positive placeholder.
transparency: The positive control observations above do not yet establish whole-scope E5. The methodology requires that minimum before a positive Transparency and Control finding; the previous positive finding is therefore withdrawn to Not assessed, not changed to Does not meet.
applications.remaining: An actual current-version blend-file interpretation, complete offline scene/dependency rebuild, pack/move comparison, editable export losses, version compatibility and script/undo safeguards. E5 needs effective script/driver/plugin trust, overwrite and destructive-edit controls plus recoverable scene state.
applications.current_remaining: An actual current-version blend-file interpretation, complete offline scene/dependency rebuild, pack/move comparison, editable export losses, version compatibility and script/undo safeguards. E5 needs effective script/driver/plugin trust, overwrite and destructive-edit controls plus recoverable scene state.
applications.next: Obtain a complete synthetic scene/dependency manifest, native source and interchange/reference outputs with expected object/node/animation semantics; inspect preserved files and reuse version-matched script/undo/save observations.
sovereignty: A positive Sovereignty finding requires established E1, E2 and E4 in the declared scope. The existing access/exit/custody record for Blender does not establish all three minimums. The prior positive finding is withdrawn; recorded storage and portability strengths remain facts, not a verified failure.

applications.name: KiCad

applications.name: OpenSCAD
applications.version: Source commit d7a210ed01e5db9f09a8164894b0d0b07d7f2c67; 3MF package/expectation inspection and binary STL information limits
E3: The independent 3MF/STL readers expose mesh geometry and units where represented, but STL does not preserve source parameters/construction meaning and one regression expectation is not standalone XML. Complete includes/fonts, source/version dependencies and equivalent generated geometry remain unestablished for the original parametric profile.
E5: Manufacturing accuracy alone is not E5. The current evidence does not establish effective model/include execution authority, file/output overwrite control, previewed consequential changes or correction after lost source edits; backup and configuration boundaries remain open.
longevity: E3 is not established for OpenSCAD's existing essential-record scope. The previous Longevity finding is replaced by Not assessed, not a verified failure or a positive placeholder.
transparency: The positive control observations above do not yet establish whole-scope E5. The methodology requires that minimum before a positive Transparency and Control finding; the previous positive finding is therefore withdrawn to Not assessed, not changed to Does not meet.
applications.remaining: Actual CGAL/Manifold equivalence, exported geometry reconstruction, parameter/color/unit losses in receiving tools, complete library/font dependency capture, source/version compatibility and crash backup behavior. E5 needs source/include execution and save/export overwrite authority, inspectability and backup/correction boundaries.
applications.current_remaining: Actual CGAL/Manifold equivalence, exported geometry reconstruction, parameter/color/unit losses in receiving tools, complete library/font dependency capture, source/version compatibility and crash backup behavior. E5 needs source/include execution and save/export overwrite authority, inspectability and backup/correction boundaries.
applications.next: Retain a synthetic parametric model with every include/font and expected geometry/unit/color manifest, then use independent parsers and externally supplied engine comparisons. Review same-version file/execution/backup controls.
E2: The former E2 Pass does not establish a replacement parametric workflow preserving source parameters, construction meaning, units and required dependencies. Mesh-only interoperability is a narrower result, not full-scope migration.
